# Notion Everything

> 550+ Notion templates, tools, and resources for organizing your life, business, and freelance work in one powerful workspace.

Notion Everything is a comprehensive platform created by co-founders Quentin Villard and Valentin Geffroy that provides premium and free Notion templates designed for productivity, business management, and personal organization. The site features flagship systems like Second Brain 3.5, Small Business OS, and Freelance OS, along with curated tools, courses, and educational content for Notion users of all levels.

## Key Topics

- Notion templates
- Second Brain system
- Project management
- Task management
- Productivity tools
- Business management
- Freelance OS
- Small Business OS
- Finance tracking
- Notion workspace
- Template bundles
- Notion integrations
- Knowledge organization
- Notion customization
- Habit tracking

## Featured Templates

- [Notion Second Brain Template - Organize Your Life From One Place](https://www.notioneverything.com/notion-second-brain): Flagship Second Brain 3.5 template for organizing tasks and knowledge
- [Small Business OS](https://www.notioneverything.com/small-business-os): All-in-one Notion template for business projects, sales, CRM and finances
- [Freelance OS - The Best Notion Freelance Template](https://www.notioneverything.com/notion-freelance-template): Comprehensive Notion template for freelancers managing projects and invoicing
- [Notion Finance Tracker Pro - Take control of your finances](https://www.notioneverything.com/notion-finance-tracker): Finance tracking template for budgets, expenses and financial dashboard
- [Task and Project Management System Notion Template](https://www.notioneverything.com/notion-project-management-template): Project management template with Kanban boards for task organization
